unchanged_boundaries: No customer-Agent capability, prompt, target or transaction semantics change.
Business Service and persistent business facts are unchanged.
B33 Stage 1-5 authority boundaries remain unchanged.
forbidden_repairs: Do not treat max retries as success.
Do not silently accept out-of-scope workspace drift.
Do not replay a fixer merely because the previous process ended.
Do not bypass or weaken existing quality tests.
required_invariants: Every terminal success condition has non-empty evidence.
Persisted COMPLETED state is revalidated on load.
Only the FIXER_RUNNING crash window permits controlled in-scope reconciliation.
Same action/state attempts are bounded per strategy.
BLOCKED records attempted strategies and a next action.
rollback_plan: Restore scripts/repair_loop.py and the modified architecture test from B33, then delete the new TaskRun schema/controller/CLI/tests and B34 delivery records. No business or database migration is involved.
